The award was presented during the WBF’s 2026–2027 Awards ceremony, held recently at Hampton Court Palace in London, NNPC said on Sunday.
Chairman of the World Branding Forum, Richard Bowles, said the organisation celebrated NNPC Limited for earning public trust, delivering exceptional experiences and consistently promoting its brand, according to a statement by NNPC chief communications officer Andy Odeh.
“We celebrate NNPC Limited for earning public trust, delivering exceptional experiences and consistently pushing the NNPC brand and setting benchmark for excellence in petroleum retail sector in Nigeria and across its borders,” he said.
Bowles explained that NNPC Limited was selected after a rigorous evaluation process involving brand valuation, consumer market research and public online voting.
“You have earned it and people should know, tell your customers, tell your staff, put it on your website and in your marketing campaigns,” he added.
Responding after receiving the award, managing director of NNPC Retail Ltd, Huub Stokman, thanked the WBF for the recognition. He said the award would encourage the company to do more in providing the best value and experience for its customers.
Stokman was represented at the event by the Director of Operations at NNPC Retail Ltd, Baba Kukawa. He dedicated the award to the entire staff of the company, saying NNPC Retail was deploying cutting-edge technology to upscale and expand its operations.
Also present at the ceremony were the Manager, External Communications and Brand Management at NNPC Ltd, Mr. Mohammed S. Umar, and the Manager, Marketing at NNPC Retail Ltd, Mrs. Henrietta A. Ogon.
The World Branding Awards is an international brand-recognition programme run by the World Branding Forum, a London-based non-profit organisation. Incorporated in 2014, the awards have operated for more than a decade, honouring global, regional and national brands through brand valuation, public voting and market research.
The awards recognise outstanding achievement in brand building, consumer trust and market influence across industries worldwide. Past recipients include energy brands such as Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) Distribution and PTT Stations.
